title: Project Yung Gun: Kerehaklu Estate, Karnataka | Cultured Washed Process | Medium Light Roast
description:
Single Origin Arabica Microlot from Kerehaklu Estate, Karnataka, India

Lot Y2 - SCA 86+ 

Medium Light Roast (250g)

Process: Cultured Washed Process

Varietal: Sarchimor

Agtron Meter: 65

Best Suited: Filter Roast

Cupper's Notes: Apricot, Maple syrup, Candied pecans


Best Brewed With

FILTER ROAST

Please note that the best brewed with list is not comprehensive and does not dictate that the coffees cannot be brewed with any other methods. These are the the methods we think will extract the best possible cup. However, this coffee can be ground and enjoyed with any brew method that you desire.

 

About the Process:

Culture Washed Process:
This microlot of Sarchimor showcases the producer’s experimental approach to fermentation. After pulping, a frozen mossto culture—crafted from indigenous microbes preserved from the previous harvest—was introduced to initiate controlled aerobic fermentation over 38 hours. The coffee was then mechanically washed and slow-dried for 20 days in a shaded polyhouse, ensuring gradual moisture loss and optimal flavour development. This meticulous process highlights both microbial innovation and environmental control at the Navilu Bande Patte Block.

About the Roast :

Medium Light Roast: At Subko, a medium-light roast is one that is obtained by dropping the coffee lot at 200°-201°C. These roasts are generally of a sensory profile that is bright, vibrant, and fruity. In terms of the Agtron scale, Subko's definition of medium-light lies between the points 75 to 89, with 89 being the lightest version of a medium-light roast, and 75 being the darkest version of the roast.


Cupper's Notes

A medium-light roast expression from Kerehaklu Estate, this cultured washed lot opens with a gentle maple syrup sweetness, leading into a bright and juicy apricot note at its core. The cup is rounded by a soft nuttiness reminiscent of candied pecans, adding depth and warmth to the profile. The structured acidity and clean finish highlight the precision of processing, while the silky texture allows the sweetness and fruit character to linger with elegance.


About Kerehaklu Estate

Kerehaklu Estate is a sustainable, biodiversity-friendly farm in Chikmagalur, Karnataka, India. Specialty coffee is grown alongside several varieties of pepper, avocados, citrus and mulberries - all in harmony with the local flora and fauna. 

Kerehaklu has been run by the Thipaiah family since 1953 and is now overseen by Pranoy Thipaiah, who is the fifth generation to do so. The farm has gone chemical-free in late 2016 and are thus experiencing a gradual influx of birds and small mammals from the neighbouring Bhadra State forest.

title: Gunibylu Estate, Karnataka | Anaerobic Yeast Naturals | Medium Dark Roast
description:
Single Origin Specialty Robusta: Gunibylu Estate, Karnataka

Medium Dark Roast (250g)

Process: Anaerobic Yeast Naturals

Agtron Meter: 58

Altitude: 1000 MASL

Varietal: Old Peredenia

Cupper's Notes: Dragon fruit, roasted almonds, dark chocolate.

Flavor Meter


Best Brewed With

OMNIROAST


Omni roasting embraces the idea that any coffee can be brewed using any method.

About the process:

Anaerobic Yeast Naturals : When coffee cherries are selectively harvested with a target ripeness of 99%, they are first washed, and floaters (defective or under-ripe cherries) are removed. The selected cherries are then placed in a stainless steel container along with a specific yeast strain for 168 hours of fermentation. After this, the cherries are transferred to raised beds for slow drying.

title: Pourtable Pourover [ Box of 6 ] (84g): The Project Pearl, Ratnagiri Estate, Karnataka
description:
Pourtable Pourover coffee bags feature Subko’s specialty Arabica blend from Project Pearl, Ratnagiri Estate, Karnataka. Each box includes six sachets, offering a floral, fruit-forward cup—this isn’t instant coffee, it’s instant you. Ready when and where you need it. 

Subko’s Pourtable Pourover is a single-cup drip coffee brewer that delivers the precision of manual brewing methods like Kalita and Origami drippers in a portable format. Just add hot water and brew anywhere.
